mr.stem: एक कंपनी इलेक्ट्रॉनिक उपकरणाची निर्मिती करते. त्या उपकरणाची किंमत ठरविताना कंपनी स्वत:साठी 10% नफा, घाऊक व्यापाऱ्यांसाठी 20% नफा व किरकोळ व्यापाऱ्यांसाठी 30% नफा अंतर्भूत करते. त्या उपकरणाची ठरविलेली किंमत त्याच्या निर्मितीमूल्यापेक्षा किती टक्के जास्त आहे ?

en.stem: A company manufactures electronic equipment. While deciding price of that equipment, the company includes 10% profit for itself. 20% profit for wholesaler and 30% profit for retailer. By how much percent is the decided price more than manufacturing cost of that equipment ?

en.stem: In a country the ratio of number of states to number of union territories is 52 : 13. By how much percentage is the number of states more than the number of union territories in that country ?

mr.stem: वर्ष 2024 मध्ये मोबाइल वापरणाऱ्यांची टक्केवारी 43% वरून 65% झाली. तर 43% च्या तुलनेत किती टक्के वाढ झाली ?

en.stem: The amount of work done by 3 men is same as that done by 5 boys. Similarly, the amount of work done by 5 women is equal to that done by 8 boys. If 12 men and 14 boys require 24 days to finish the work, then how many days will be needed for 9 men, 15 women and 12 boys to complete the work ?
